cellar.name: The flooded cellar
cellar.description: Ankle-deep water, a smell of wet stone. A rusted grate is set into the far wall, its bars bent apart just short of a gap you could fit through. A packing crate floats against one corner. A brass lantern hangs from a nail, unlit.

objects.grate: A rusted iron grate over a low opening. The bars are bent but not bent enough.
objects.crate: A wooden packing crate, waterlogged but solid enough to stand on.
objects.lantern: A brass lantern hanging from a nail. There is oil in it. It is not lit.
objects.water: Cold standing water, about ankle deep.

tunnel.name: The service tunnel
tunnel.description: A brick tunnel running east, low enough that you stoop. A crowbar lies in the muck where someone dropped it. At the far end, a steel door with a keypad beside it, its cover hanging off.

objects.crowbar: A heavy steel crowbar, pitted with rust but intact.
objects.door: A steel door with no handle on this side. A keypad beside it, cover hanging off.
objects.keypad: A keypad with its cover hanging off, wires exposed.
objects.muck: Silt and brick dust, deep enough to hide things in.

yard.name: The loading yard
yard.description: Open air at last. Floodlights, a chain-link fence, and a gate standing open onto the road.

objects.fence: Chain-link fence, taller than you, topped with nothing in particular.
